class.name: OcgGeomEllipse
class.brief_description: Describes an ellipse in 3D space. An ellipse is defined by its major and minor radii and, as with any conic curve, is positioned in space with a right-handed coordinate system (gp_Ax2 object) where: - the origin is the center of the ellipse, - the "X Direction" defines the major axis, and - the "Y Direction" defines the minor axis. The origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of this coordinate system define the plane of the ellipse. The coordinate system is the local coordinate system of the ellipse. The "main Direction" of this coordinate system is the vector normal to the plane of the ellipse. The axis, of which the origin and unit vector are respectively the origin and "main Direction" of the local coordinate system, is termed the "Axis" or "main Axis" of the ellipse. The "main Direction" of the local coordinate system gives an explicit orientation to the ellipse (definition of the trigonometric sense), determining the direction in which the parameter increases along the ellipse. The Geom_Ellipse ellipse is parameterized by an angle: P(U) = O + MajorRad*Cos(U)*XDir + MinorRad*Sin(U)*YDir where: - P is the point of parameter U, - O, XDir and YDir are respectively the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of its local coordinate system, - MajorRad and MinorRad are the major and minor radii of the ellipse. The "X Axis" of the local coordinate system therefore defines the origin of the parameter of the ellipse. An ellipse is a closed and periodic curve. The period is 2.*Pi and the parameter range is [ 0, 2.*Pi [.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Constructs an ellipse by conversion of the gp_Elips ellipse E.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs an ellipse defined by its major and minor radii, MajorRadius and MinorRadius, where A2 locates the ellipse and defines its orientation in 3D space such that: - the center of the ellipse is the origin of A2, - the "X Direction" of A2 defines the major axis of the ellipse, i.e. the major radius MajorRadius is measured along this axis, - the "Y Direction" of A2 defines the minor axis of the ellipse, i.e. the minor radius MinorRadius is measured along this axis, - A2 is the local coordinate system of the ellipse. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if: - MajorRadius is less than MinorRadius, or - MinorRadius is less than 0. Warning The Geom package does not prevent the construction of an ellipse where MajorRadius and MinorRadius are equal.

method.name: SetElips
method.description: Converts the gp_Elips ellipse E into this ellipse.

method.name: SetMajorRadius
method.description: Assigns a value to the major radius of this ellipse. ConstructionError raised if MajorRadius < MinorRadius.

method.name: SetMinorRadius
method.description: Assigns a value to the minor radius of this ellipse. ConstructionError raised if MajorRadius < MinorRadius or if MinorRadius < 0.

method.name: Elips
method.description: returns the non transient ellipse from gp with the same

method.name: ReversedParameter
method.description: Computes the parameter on the reversed ellipse for the point of parameter U on this ellipse. For an ellipse, the returned value is: 2.*Pi - U.

method.name: Directrix1
method.description: This directrix is the line normal to the XAxis of the ellipse in the local plane (Z = 0) at a distance d = MajorRadius / e from the center of the ellipse, where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. This line is parallel to the "YAxis". The intersection point between directrix1 and the "XAxis" is the "Location" point of the directrix1. This point is on the positive side of the "XAxis". Raised if Eccentricity = 0.0. (The ellipse degenerates into a circle)

method.name: Directrix2
method.description: This line is obtained by the symmetrical transformation of "Directrix1" with respect to the "YAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: Eccentricity
method.description: Returns the eccentricity of the ellipse between 0.0 and 1.0 If f is the distance between the center of the ellipse and the Focus1 then the eccentricity e = f / MajorRadius. Returns 0 if MajorRadius = 0

method.name: Focal
method.description: Computes the focal distance. It is the distance between the the two focus of the ellipse.

method.name: Focus1
method.description: Returns the first focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the positive side of the "XAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: Focus2
method.description: Returns the second focus of the ellipse. This focus is on the negative side of the "XAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: MajorRadius
method.description: Returns the major radius of this ellipse.

method.name: MinorRadius
method.description: Returns the minor radius of this ellipse.

method.name: Parameter
method.description: Returns p = (1 - e * e) * MajorRadius where e is the eccentricity of the ellipse. Returns 0 if MajorRadius = 0

method.name: FirstParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the first parameter of this ellipse. This is respectively: - 0.0, which gives the start point of this ellipse, or The start point and end point of an ellipse are coincident.

method.name: LastParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the last parameter of this ellipse. This is respectively: - 2.*Pi, which gives the end point of this ellipse. The start point and end point of an ellipse are coincident.

method.name: IsClosed
method.description: return True.

method.name: IsPeriodic
method.description: return True.

method.name: D0
method.description: Returns in P the point of parameter U. P = C + MajorRadius * Cos (U) * XDir + MinorRadius * Sin (U) * YDir where C is the center of the ellipse , XDir the direction of the "XAxis" and "YDir" the "YAxis" of the ellipse.

method.name: D2
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U. The vectors V1 and V2 are the first and second derivatives at this point.

method.name: D3
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U, the first second and third derivatives V1 V2 and V3.

method.name: DN
method.description: For the point of parameter U of this ellipse, computes the vector corresponding to the Nth derivative. Exceptions Standard_RangeError if N is less than 1.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this ellipse.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this ellipse.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
